source: 2014/TSB Vol 14 No 10 - Flat Brake Bleeder Adapter (New) - 98010 Discontinued.pdf
title: Flat Brake Bleeder Adapter for All Brake Fluid Exchanger Machines
lead: MOC has developed a new Flat Brake Bleeder Adapter. This new adapter provides improved access to the wheel areas that are hard to reach when installing the machine's bleeder lines.
body: The old Brake Bleeder Adapter (Part # 98010) has been discontinued and replaced with this new adapter.
